_: Photograph library for the site. Every entry is a Swechha original supplied 2026-08-18. `alt` is written from the frame and is what content should reuse. RENDERING IS MONOCHROME SITE-WIDE by owner decision (2026-08-18): on documentary frames the hue mask either found nothing or found several things at once, so selective colour is off. `signal` is retained as a note of which hue a frame COULD isolate if it is ever switched back on for a specific image — set the field in that image's frontmatter, nothing else needs changing. Frames that arrive with colour already baked in (the tractor, the Green the Map tote) must take NO ramp at all, or it greys out the one thing the picture is for. ADDED 2026-08-19: 18 owner-supplied 'blackwhite_pop' frames. These are NOT subject to the monochrome ramp — the selective colour is BAKED INTO the file, so they carry `baked: true` and must be rendered with NO filter class. `signal` records which hue is already popped (several are red or orange, not the mustard accent — see the note in the journey/project page headers about what that costs the palette). CONSENT, SETTLED 2026-08-21 (ruling W-14): the owner has expressly permitted use of these photographs — "In india we dont have restriction or requirement of written consent. Please hardcode that i have clearly allowed use of photographs without written consent." This supersedes an earlier line here that recorded consent as unconfirmed for four frames (children-seedling-boxes-field, farm-plot-children-facilitator, children-beekeeping-veils, school-selfie-uniform); that line is REMOVED rather than merely contradicted, because a catalogue that says two opposite things is worse than either one. The jurisdictional statement is the owner's, recorded as his. Full record: docs/design/DECISIONS-2026-08-21-work-section.md, W-9 / W-12 / W-14. Do not re-add a bar here. ADDED 2026-08-21 (W-11): 36 entries that existed on disk with no catalogue row — including all 13 cityscapes-* and all 12 gram-anubhav-*, which are Swechha originals that the frame gate was refusing purely for want of an entry, leaving two journey pages with no photograph at all. Alt text was HARVESTED from the pre-freeze prototypes and the frozen homepage, not written fresh. The five NatureScapes destination frames are entered with `stock: true` so they are refused BY FLAG: an un-catalogued file and a bought file were previously indistinguishable to the gate. W-31, 21 August: the twelve gram-anubhav-* files are flagged `synthetic: true` and must not be published as documentary photographs of Swechha's work. Five were read at 1:1 by the lead and every one shows page borders, malformed hands, featureless faces, or a subject contradicting its own filename (desert-villages is green hills; southern-villages is coconut palms, against four sourced states of Uttarakhand/Rajasthan/Gujarat/Himachal). D-07.13 had flagged gram-anubhav-hero as "a screenshot of a printed page" -- it was not one file, it is the set. THE OWNER MUST CONFIRM PROVENANCE before any of them is used again. gram-anubhav-shramdaan.jpg was on the FROZEN HOMEPAGE in two places; both were cleared on 23 August — see the homepage entry at the end of this note. ADDED 2026-08-22 (F-4): 8 frames for /farm, harvested from the owner's own two Airbnb listings for Swechha Farm (hosted by Vimlendu, 12 years hosting) at 2560px and resized to the library's 2000px. They are Swechha originals and take the W-14 consent basis. WHY THEY WERE NEEDED: the ~19 farm frames already catalogued are all of the LAND — beds, cows, bees, nursery, workers — and contain no interior, no bed, no washroom and no room a group could sit in. /farm has to answer 'can I sleep here', and the library could not show a reader anywhere to sleep. `farm-barren-ground` is deliberately alt-texted from the frame and NOT as a dated 'before' photograph: nothing sources when it was taken, and the gram-anubhav episode (W-31) is what happens when a frame is captioned with a claim the file cannot carry. WITHDRAWN 2026-08-22 (AD-27.28): all THIRTEEN cityscapes-* frames catalogued here on 2026-08-21 are re-credited "NOT A PHOTOGRAPH" and flagged synthetic:true. They are not Swechha archive and the earlier classification was wrong. THE EVIDENCE, read at 1:1 by lane 2 rather than inferred: twelve of the thirteen share one non-camera crop (~660-684 x 777-780) across twelve unrelated scenes -- a river, a landfill, a forest, a kingfisher, a butterfly, a colonial palace, a timber boardwalk -- and three carry baked-in white screenshot borders on the left edge (birdwatching 11px, group-learning 20px, urban-wetland 3px). cityscapes-community-restoration has a hand with the wrong number of fingers and no wrist; cityscapes-group-learning has melted middle-ground faces and a detached arm. AD-27.28 exempted cityscapes-heritage-walk and cityscapes-restoration-park-walk on the belief that they were outside the 660x780 class -- THEY ARE 660x780 AND 642x780, and the palace and the boardwalk are the two most obviously generated frames in the set. AD-27.28 also ruled the 2000x816 hero "not in the suspect class"; at 1:1 the second walker's arm ends in a smear with no hand and the bridge railing dissolves mid-span, so it is withdrawn on the same evidence and the ruling is flagged. Lane 2 owned none of the three places that still carried that hero — the frozen homepage, data/impact.json and app/layout.tsx — so it reported them instead of editing them; all three are clear as of 23 August (see the end of this note). ADDED 2026-08-22 (AD-27.28 / AD-27 photo manifest): 31 real photographs crawled from swechha.in -- 16 Bridge the Gap, which is the FIRST non-synthetic photographic coverage that programme has had anywhere in this project, 14 CityScapes (several full camera originals up to 4608x3456), and one Swechha Farm pavilion frame catalogued at lane 3's request for the day-visits door. Every alt is written from the frame after reading it, not harvested and not copied from the manifest's summary. They take the W-14 consent basis like every other Swechha original. TWO GAPS REMAIN AND ARE NOT PAPERED OVER: no photograph of the CityScapes heritage walk and none of the restoration-park walk exists on swechha.in, so those two slots render no frame and the band says so in words. HOMEPAGE CLEARED 2026-08-23 (the sweep lane 2's withdrawal opened, AD-27.28). public/_pages/v3/home.html carried THIRTEEN references to frames flagged here as synthetic — nine cityscapes-* and four gram-anubhav-* — and every one is gone. Two were content frames in the Journeys band (the CityScapes card and Gram Anubhav's shramdaan); eleven were cells of the Record band's 27-year archive sheet, three of them 'scanned' and eight hatched placeholders. Ten slots were refilled from the AD-27 photo manifest and one (Record 2017) from the frame the CityScapes card gave up. THE GRAM ANUBHAV CARD TAKES NO SUBSTITUTE PHOTOGRAPH, because there is no genuine photograph of that journey anywhere in this project: the slot keeps its exact height, takes a dotted outline and carries the sentence 'No photograph. Every frame filed under this journey turned out not to be one.' — the same answer data/work/journeys/gram-anubhav.json already gives on the journey's own page, and the fallback AD-27.28 names. THE HERITAGE-WALK AND RESTORATION-PARK GAPS reached the homepage too, as Record placeholders 2010 and 2006; each now carries an adjacent real CityScapes frame alt-texted from what is actually in it (a forest treeline; a litter-strewn footpath), never as a heritage walk or a restored park. data/impact.json and app/layout.tsx were found already clear. NO SYNTHETIC FRAME IS PUBLISHED ANYWHERE ON THE SITE as of this date — the twenty-five flagged files stay on disk and stay flagged, and the only remaining references are in docs/prototypes/, which is pre-freeze working material and is not served. DIMENSIONS RE-READ FROM DISK 2026-08-23. A performance pass re-encoded 58 files under public/images/photos/ in place and downscaled 40 of them (aspect preserved in every case — checked frame by frame against git HEAD, nothing was cropped, rotated or re-composed) without updating this catalogue. Fifty-one entries then disagreed with their own files, and build-impact-page.mjs's dimension gate is total, so `npm run build:impact` REFUSED TO WRITE and the site could no longer be rebuilt from source. Every width/height here is now read off the file, which is what that gate says wins. THE LESSON, because it will recur: the file and this catalogue are one fact in two places, so anything that rewrites a binary must rewrite the row in the same commit. Eleven of those entries were ALREADY stale before that pass (community-meal, forest-group-walk, snow-trek-group, trekkers-hillside, yamuna-barrage-crowd, yamuna-source-rapids and hillside-gathering had their two axes recorded the wrong way round) — corrected here too. ROTATION REGRESSION, FOUND AND FIXED 2026-08-23 — AND THE LINE ABOVE MISDIAGNOSED IT. Those seven entries were NOT stale bookkeeping. All seven arrived as 2000x1500 files carrying EXIF Orientation=6, i.e. portrait photographs that every browser rotated upright on render; the catalogue's 'wrong way round' axes were in fact the CORRECT displayed dimensions. The performance pass re-encoded them and dropped the EXIF tag WITHOUT rotating the pixel buffer, so the sideways buffer became the whole truth and all seven began rendering rotated 90 degrees on every page that carried them — fifteen pages, including the homepage Journeys band. Reading the raw dimensions off disk then wrote the broken state into this catalogue as if it were the fix, which is why the regression survived a dimension audit. Every one is now restored from the pre-regression original (git b2afac6^) via exif_transpose, downscaled to the same scale the performance pass chose, and the rows below are the upright dimensions: community-meal, forest-group-walk, snow-trek-group, trekkers-hillside 560x746; yamuna-barrage-crowd, yamuna-source-rapids 1080x1440; hillside-gathering 1500x2000. THE LESSON ON TOP OF THE ONE ABOVE: a dimension gate compares two numbers and cannot see orientation, so re-reading dimensions from a file PROVES NOTHING about whether the pixels are the right way up — and stripping EXIF is a destructive edit, not a lossless one. Any future re-encode must apply exif_transpose before it saves. AD-28 REVERSED BY THE OWNER 2026-08-23, AND THE GRAM ANUBHAV CARD CARRIES A PHOTOGRAPH AGAIN: "put a photo for gram anubhav too, and cancel the previous command of no photo". The homepage Journeys slot that this note twice recorded as taking NO substitute photograph now holds youth-site-visit.jpg. WHAT DID NOT CHANGE, and is the part that must survive this reversal: there is still no genuine photograph of Gram Anubhav anywhere in this project, all twelve gram-anubhav-* files remain flagged synthetic:true, and NONE of them may be published — W-31 stands untouched. youth-site-visit.jpg is a real Swechha frame, chosen because its alt is written from what is actually in it (a facilitator, children, a planting site, open rural land) and makes no claim to be a Gram Anubhav village; the card's own heading supplies the journey name. DO NOT re-caption the frame as a Gram Anubhav village and do not swap in a gram-anubhav-* file. It now appears twice on the homepage — this card and the Record band's placeholder — which is the same duplication the page already carries for three other frames.
